posts.zh:
dsh-file-drop 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。拖拽/点击上传任意非图片文件（PDF/Word/Excel/ZIP/文本）到输入框：桌面壳下直取 Finder 原始路径；无壳时上传到工作区并插入路径。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-969a8d0dbe0827466c47.html
posts.en:
dsh-file-drop is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Drag & drop or click to attach any non-image file (PDF/Word/Excel/ZIP/text) into the composer: in the desktop shell it resolves the real Finder path instantly; otherwise it uploads to the workspace and inserts the path.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-969a8d0dbe0827466c47.html
